title: Public Services Emergency Response FAQ Chatbot
description: Develop a generative AI chatbot prototype for public services to provide real-time, accurate emergency response information. Problem: Overwhelming call volumes, misinformation, and insufficient static FAQs during emergencies. Data: Use emergency guidelines, FAQs, scenario scripts (100 Q&A pairs); preprocess with normalization and tagging; prioritize synthetic/anonymized public data for privacy and quality. Solution: Conversational interface supporting FAQs, follow-up questions, context-sensitive responses, scenario selection, and fallback handling. Integrate with static FAQ datasets. Metrics: High answer accuracy, response time under 5 seconds. Demo: Live user interaction with emergency scenarios. Explore creative aligned solutions.
business_case_summary:
Business Case Summary: Public Services Emergency Response FAQ Chatbot (DEM-2026-0013)

Executive Summary
Develop a generative AI chatbot prototype for public services to deliver real-time emergency FAQs, reducing call volumes and misinformation via conversational interfaces and preprocessed datasets.

Direct Business Value/Impact
Enhances response accuracy and speed (under 5 seconds), improving public safety. Aligns with approved AI projects like DEM-2026-0011 for high-impact prototypes.

Potential Risk Mitigation
Prioritize synthetic/anonymized data for privacy; enforce accuracy metrics and fallbacks. High risk offset by recent domain successes (e.g., DEM-2026-0012).
